QUOTE: Guards the `deleteReactions` branch, so no stale rows are destroyed. ... If the local DB holds a reaction the server has since removed, the add event will not clean it up.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that `skipSync: true` makes `sanitizeReactions` return only creates with `deleteReactions` empty, so existing reactions are not deleted. That is the same mechanism the item describes.
